title: Mirror axis and reflection move
description: The selected mirror axis (a band) moves with the arrow keys, and the reflected image moves with it.

title: Piece and reflection move
description: The selected piece moves with the arrow keys; its reflection on the other side of the mirror moves, appears or disappears with it.

title: Selection highlight
description: Selecting another piece or mirror axis moves the highlight from the old target to the new one.

title: Step bar (right edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Container tilts or moves
description: An action changes the orientation or the position of the container (a bucket).

title: Step bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Container colour
description: Clicking a colour changes the colour inside the container (or the crane) to it.

title: Colour selection marker
description: The underline that marks the selected colour moves to the new selection.

title: Pour target fills
description: Pouring from the container fills the target area with its colour.

title: Bridge rotates
description: The red and pink pieces (the bridge) rotate about the dark centre.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Course tiles switch
description: Pressing the blue button switches the tiles on the course between a checkered and a plain blue pattern.

title: Key pickup
description: When the player reaches a key, the key leaves the board and the matching button appears in the right panel.

title: Player moves
description: The player moves with the arrow keys.

title: Switch frame cleared
description: Pressing the blue button removes the frame around the switch in the right panel until a reset.

title: Click bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining clicks on the bottom edge shortens at each action.

title: Tile colour switches
description: The clicked tile changes colour.

title: Step bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Edge band
description: When the player block touches a wall, a hole or another block, a thin white band appears on that side or leaves it.

title: Selected block moves
description: The selected block (white centre) moves with the arrow keys. When it bumps into a block that slides on, that block's move is pushed_block.

title: Controlled block switches
description: Switching the controlled block changes the centre colour of the old and the new block.

title: Pushed block slides
description: The selected block bumps into another block, which slides on while the selected one stays.

title: Step bar (left edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Tile row shifts left
description: A click shifts a connected row of tiles by one place to the left (counter-clockwise on a ring).

title: Tile row shifts right
description: A click shifts a connected row of tiles by one place to the right (clockwise on a ring).

title: Key rotates
description: When the player steps on a rotation cell, the key piece in the corner rotates, on the board and in its HUD copy.

title: Player moves
description: The 5 x 5 player block moves one tile (5 cells) with the arrow keys.

title: Return to start
description: When the steps run out, the player returns to the start and the board is restored (refills and the HUD piece come back).

title: Step refill
description: Stepping on a refill item fills the step bar on the bottom edge; once the player leaves the cell, the item is gone.

title: Step bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Step bar (top edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Mirrored step bar (bottom edge)
description: The mirrored bar on the bottom edge shortens at each action.

title: Mirrored player moves
description: Moving the player moves the mirrored player symmetrically.

title: Player moves
description: The directly controlled player moves with the arrow keys.

title: Leg selection
description: Switching the controlled leg changes the colours of the newly selected and the deselected leg.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Goal frame
description: When the body of the robot reaches a goal, a white 7 x 7 frame appears over the goal until the body leaves.

title: Robot moves
description: Clicking moves a leg, and the legs, the body and the string between them move together.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Piece moves
description: The selected piece moves with the arrow keys; its shape can change.

title: Piece selection
description: Selecting another piece switches the selection marker.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Arm rotates and extends
description: A click rotates the telescopic arm and extends or retracts it.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Selection box
description: The selection box (the cursor square) appears, moves or changes state.

title: Tile changes
description: The clicked tile changes its appearance or colour, including moving into a slot.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Player moves
description: The player moves with the arrow keys. The position correction that comes with a size change is player_resize.

title: Player grows or shrinks
description: Casting a spell enlarges or shrinks the player.

title: Spell slots
description: The grid of spell slots changes.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Colour blocks pushed
description: Pushed by the skewer, the colour blocks move, stretch or change shape.

title: Match indicator
description: The indicator that shows whether the blocks match the target switches.

title: Skewer extends
description: The shaft of the controlled skewer extends or retracts; its head stays.

title: Skewer moves
description: The controlled skewer moves up or down with its head and pushes the colour blocks ahead of it.

title: Fruits merge
description: A click draws smaller fruits into a larger one, and they become one (the movement in that step included).

title: Fruits move
description: A click moves fruits without changing their number.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Step bar
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Instruction button
description: The clicked instruction button switches its state.

title: Reference display
description: In level 2, selecting a program changes the reference pose (the example display), which then stays.

title: Program selector
description: The clicked program selection button switches its state.

title: Step bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Selection brackets
description: The upper and the lower selection bracket move together.

title: Slot symbol
description: The symbol in the selected slot is replaced in place by another.

title: Step bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Enemy ball
description: The enemy ball moves on its own; the dots on its face change colour, or it bursts.

title: Player moves
description: The player block on the path moves and turns with the arrow keys.

title: Boat moves
description: A click moves a boat-shaped part with a coloured block.

title: Step bar (top edge)
description: The bar on the top edge shortens at each action; it can also refill.

title: Waves
description: A click moves the edge of a white area, which widens or narrows.

title: Step bar (bottom edge)
description: The bar of remaining steps shortens at each action.

title: Controlled block moves
description: The green block moves and turns with the arrow keys and carries a grabbed object with it.

title: Orange agent moves
description: The orange agent moves.

title: Facing frame
description: When the controlled block faces an adjacent object, a grey frame appears on the object; it goes when the block leaves.

title: Grab frame
description: Grabbing the adjacent object changes its frame to the grabbed colour (white for the selector, black for other agents); releasing restores it.
